name: Decision Tree Diagram
when_to_pick: Show a branching trading decision as a fully-rendered top-down tree the reader can take in at a glance: a root decision, labelled branches (e.g. Yes / No, conditions met / not met), and terminal verdict cards toned success (take the trade / favourable path) or danger (skip it / risk path). Use to turn an 'it depends' rule into a visible flowchart of every path and outcome. This is a static HTML/CSS tree (no Mermaid), so it renders identically in print, RSS, and dark/light themes.

title.description: Optional heading shown above the tree (e.g. 'Should I take this breakout trade?').

caption.description: Optional one-line takeaway shown under the tree, delivering the aha.

kind.description: 'decision' = a branching question/condition node with children; 'outcome' = a terminal verdict card (no children).

label.description: Node text. For a decision: the question/condition. For an outcome: the verdict headline.

detail.description: Optional secondary line. For a decision: a clarifying hint. For an outcome: the action / reasoning.

tone.description: Outcome emphasis: success = green favourable path, danger = red skip/risk path, warning = amber caution. Decisions are usually 'default'.

branches.description: Children of a decision node. Each branch has a short edge label (e.g. 'Yes', 'No', '> 1.5R') and a child node.

label.description: Edge label printed on the connector (kept short so it never wraps).
